# Review — cid-tiradas-132-133 (vv. 2863–2967, tiradas 132–133)

Checked: every unit's `t`/`l`/`i`/`n` (41 units) against the pinned packet and conventions.md; the scan, PDF pp. 310–315
(printed 306–311), read at zoom 1.4, with clips at zoom 4–8 of v. 2893 (*d' aquí*), v. 2876 (*p[as]sar*), v. 2960
(*lê*, *sín*), the margin label at v. 2930 and the footnotes to 2864 and 2867. Both rubrics (132, 133, and 134 for the
note at 2967) and every Pidal footnote on these pages (2864, 2867, 2872, 2875, 2876, 2877, 2879, 2884, 2887, 2890,
2907, 2914, 2919, 2922, 2924, 2925, 2928, 2936, 2941, 2950, 2953, 2958, 2959, 2963) were compared with the notes
letter by letter. Cross-references checked in the published parts: vv. 1, 204, 434, 858, 1312, 1380, 1394, 1396,
1464, 1499, 1577, 1880, 1941, 2072, 2255, 2613, 2618, 2635, 2636, 2640, 2647, 2652, 2653, 2673, 2707, 2731–2733,
2852, 2862 (Pidal's note to 2733 read from the published 128–130 note). House renderings checked against 102–131.

The `t` fields joined by "\n" equal the packet's 105 verses in order; no `t` was changed; every `l` has as many
lines as its `t`; the longest unit is 4 lines (verified by script after editing). Both files parse.

## Pass 1: units.json

1. 2863–2864 · n · style. Pidal's note to 2864 prints *Verso dificil* (a *fi* ligature, no accent; checked at zoom 6);
   the note quoted *difícil*. Now as printed, said in the note.
2. 2875–2877 · n · style. "o = do, 'where'": *o* is ó 'where' (house, vv. 102, 2618), not a form of *do*. Now
   "o = ó, 'where'".
3. 2878–2880 · i · weak. "the town they call Medina; and from Medinaceli to Molina": the same town under two names,
   against the house (Medina "Medinaceli" in `i`). Now "the place they call Medinaceli; and from Medinaceli …"; the
   note says so.
4. 2878–2880 · l · style. *a qual dizen Medina* "at which they-call": *a* is the 'to' of the motion (Pidal 'a la que
   llaman'). Now "to which they-call Medina".
5. 2885–2887 · l · style. *llegava* imperfect rendered "arrived"; now "was-arriving" (`i` "came" kept).
6. 2888–2889 · n · style. "ívalas = las iva, 'he went (to) them'": *las* is the object of *abraçar*, drawn up onto
   *iva*. Rewritten.
7. 2890–2891 · l · style. *curie* present subjunctive rendered "guard"; now "may-guard".
8. 2892–2894 · n · weak. The reader-facing note carried pipeline chatter ("the scan prints aquí …, the pinned text
   aqui (a flag for the reviewer)"). Removed; the matter is reported to the owner (see the ruling below), not to the
   reader.
9. 2914–2916 · n · style. The paraphrase of Pidal's note to 2733 now includes what it says of the *juntas* (district
   judicial assemblies, less solemn than the cortes), which supports the rendering "assemblies".

Rulings on the drafter's flags and other points checked, no change:
- **2893 *aqui* / *aquí*** — the scan (p. 308, first line, clip at zoom 6) prints *aquí* with an acute accent: a
  slanted stroke over the i, plainly different from the round dot of every i nearby (*ivan*, *mio*). The establishing
  record "aqui unaccented as printed" is wrong. Pidal's footnote to 2867 also prints *aquí*. `t` not changed (pinned);
  the pinned source should be corrected to *d' aquí* in an establish action, and this part rebuilt.
- **2864 *otro tanto las ha*** — Pidal's footnote quoted exactly (apart from item 1); taking his second guess
  (*fablado las ha*) and saying it is uncertain is right.
- **2876 *p[as]sar*** — at zoom 6 the p is roman, the a italic (single-storey), the final *ar* roman; the two s's
  cannot be told apart at the scan's resolution. The established *p[as]sar* is consistent with the print; the note's
  statement of uncertainty stands.
- **2926 *ellos*** — e + los 'and the' taken, *ellos* 'they' named as possible. Kept; uncertain. (The glosser's
  broaden contradicted it; fixed in Pass 2.)
- **2960 *sín*, *lê*** — the print has *lê* (circumflex) and *sín* (acute), checked at zoom 4. *sín* = sí + me with n
  for m is the likeliest reading; no footnote from Pidal. Kept; uncertain.
- **2962 *reyno mio*** — no note from Pidal; nothing added. Right.
- **2930** — the margin prints *2030* (a round 0, not a 9; zoom 6). The note is right.
- **2967** — no closing quote: tirada 134 opens with Pidal's continuation quote (*”Dizidle al Campeador*). Right.
- **Footnote oddities** — 2867 *sino que se espere*, 2879 no closing quote, 2919 *en casa de Cid*, 2884 headword
  *adeliñeche*: all confirmed on the print; the notes quote them correctly.
- **2941 *la ondra que es cuntida a nos*** — rendered with Pidal's paraphrase; "what honour that marriage brought
  us" keeps whatever edge the words have without adding irony. Kept.
- **Footnote quotations** — all the others listed in the header are exact (inner quotes converted to double quotes
  as in earlier parts). Rubrics 132, 133 and 134 exact.
- **Grammar labels** — ayades, veamos, podamos, perdiestes, podredes, yazen, troçieron, de[x]an, métense, plaz,
  saliólos, nasco, llegava, ívalas, tornós, Venides, curie, Plega, vea, faga, entráronse, fablós, crié, Lieves, bésale,
  pese, an fecha, gelas, han dexadas, cabe, se me an levado, Adúgamelos, aya, sirvan, Salien, nos = non se, falló,
  descavalga, omillós, ví[d]olos, levantós, besábale, Casastes, quisiestes, es cuntida, abiltados, Afélas, gelos,
  levedes, tienes = tiénese, comidió, fizlo, ff[o]sse, pésanos, lê, cuydava, andarán, pregonarán, vayan, mandaré,
  den, podiéndolo: all right after the edits above.
- **Remembered translation** — none found.

## Pass 2: gloss.json

1. cuydava · error. Labelled 3rd sg. 'he thought … what he did not intend': the king is speaking, 1st sg. (`l`
   "I-was-thinking"). Fixed.
2. porteros · error. 'doorkeeper, usher, herald' against Pidal's note to 2963 and the glossary's *portero* ('the
   king's officer … not a door-keeper here'). Rewritten from the note; "officers", as the unit.
3. __broaden__ ellos · error. The new sense 'those, the' (demonstrative/article) contradicts the unit (e + los 'and
   the'). Now e + los, with 'they' in apposition named as possible, reading uncertain.
4. escurriéndolos · weak. 'seeing them off … sense inferred from the context': the house keeps "see off" for a
   farewell and "escort" for an escort on the road (vv. 2640, 2652; Pidal 'acompáñelas'). Rewritten; = acompañándolos.
5. bésale · weak. 'kiss for him': *le* is the possessor ('kiss his hand'). Fixed.
6. juntas · weak. Example 'to interviews or meetings' against the house *vistas* "meeting" and the unit's "assembly".
   Rewritten, with Pidal's note to 2733.
7. berlanga · weak. "Berlanga de Duero" goes beyond Pidal's note (pueblo y castillo …). Dropped.
8. rio · weak. 'River of Love' is not in Pidal and the name is unexplained. Dropped.
9. cuntida · weak. "said bitterly" against the unit, which follows Pidal's plain paraphrase. Now quotes the paraphrase.
10. infantes · weak. "written with lower-case i" missed the point (ifantes is also lower-case): it is the n spelling.
    Fixed.
11. ffosse · weak. Example 'to their advantage': *su pro* is the Çid's ('his', as the unit). Fixed.
12. sín · weak. Lemma given as *sín* with 'apparently an -n'; now sí + me (?), as the unit, with the uncertainty and
    the absence of a note from Pidal stated.
13. __broaden__ sazón · weak. "Pidal" cited for 'time, season': he has no note here. Attribution dropped; example now
    *de toda esta sazón* 'in all this season', as the unit.
14. __broaden__ cort · weak (added). The known 'court, royal or lordly household' does not cover the court proclaimed
    as a solemn assembly for judgement (*pregonarán mi[e] cort*, Pidal note to 2963).
15. lê · style. Recast in the pattern of *mê*, *lâ*, *lês* (le + he, circumflex for the run-together words).
16. andarán · style. 'my heralds' → 'my officers', as the unit and porteros.
17. ívalas · style. 'he went (to) them' → 'he went (to embrace) them', as the unit.
18. fablós · style. "= habló, se habló": *se habló* is not a modern form. Now = habló.
19. adeliñechos · style. Pidal's headword *adeliñeche* named; = derechos, en derechura.
20. alcoçeva · style. 'a place passed on the way' → the Alcoceba (a ravine, Pidal); 'Gormaz castle' worded as Pidal.
21. asturias · style. 'the northern kingdom, here part of Alfonso's lands' (not Pidal) → plain, with the example.
22. toledo · style. 'the city on the Tajo' not in Pidal's note; dropped.
23. podiéndolo · style. 'when I can prevent it' → 'I being able to prevent it', i.e. as far as I can, as the unit.
24. __broaden__ otro · style. 'Pero Vermúdez likewise' → 'Per Vermudoz as much (said) to them', as the unit.

The broadens of *él*, *bien*, *assí*, *contra*, *largos*, *quier*, *levedes*, *quomo*, *den*, *desnudas* are needed and
correct. Every broaden begins with the known entry exactly as in cid-glossary.json + " · also" (verified by script,
14 now). gloss.json parses; its keys equal the 70 novel-form tokens plus `__broaden__`. The rest of the entries
(cuydado, perdiestes, podamos, vengar, dándoles, espidieron, adiestro, bado, métense, cena, besándolas, tomé, osé,
besaron, entráronse, cibdad, tardar, crié, lieves, pese, casó, mies, di, desonor, cabe, poca, levado, adúgamelos,
çalvador, yaguo, gallizanos, omillós, aguardan, sseñor, coñosció, levantós, besábale, reynos, besa, casastes,
quisiestes, afélas, desondrado, calló, dizes, casé, fizlo, pésanos, pregonarán) were checked against the form, the
units and Pidal's notes and found right.

## Refused

- 2890 `i` "You are come, my daughters!" for the question *¿Venides …?*: the house renders the same greeting so at
  v. 204 ("You are come, Martín Antolínez"), and Pidal calls it a formula of greeting. Kept.
- 2868 `i` "May we live to see the day": *live to* is added, but v. 204–205 has "May I yet live to see the day". Kept.
- 2958 `i` "Would that the marriage had never been made!" drops *oy* 'today'; it means 'as things stand', and the
  English carries it. Kept.
- 2864 `l` *las* "to-them": an accusative, but with the verb supplied ("has (said)") the English needs "to". Kept.
- *coñosció* lemma *conoscer*: the glossary lemmatizes *conosçe* so. Kept.
- No broaden for *sabidor* ('one who knows' covers *commo sodes sabidor*), *commo* ('that', 'as' already listed),
  *vayan*, *derecho*, *casa* ('town' already listed), *teniendo* (tener armas already listed).

## Left uncertain

- *ellos* (2926): e + los 'and the' taken; 'they' possible.
- *sín* (2960): sí + me with n for m; no note from Pidal.
- *otro tanto las ha* (2864): Pidal's second guess *fablado* taken; Pidal himself calls the line difficult.
- Italic extent of *p[as]sar* (2876): a italic, the s's undecidable at the scan's resolution.
- *reyno mio* (2962) as an ó-line: no note from Pidal.
- 2893: the print has *aquí*; the pinned text has *aqui* — for the owner to correct in the established text.
